rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); S727: Antelope Valley 43028, held for a person in S713, collected with its gap named

gaps.ge_figures_other_pattern: The degree names one general education pattern, and the page prints general education figures only for other patterns, so no units for the named pattern were read and the degree's units cannot be added. Its major adds up to the printed major total.

records.words: Degree total of 60 is taken from the 'Total Degree Units 60 / 60' row of a CSU/IGETC table. That table also prints GE 39 (CSU) / 37 (IGETC) and transferable electives 9-18 / 6-11. Because those figures refer to CSU GE and IGETC rather than the Cal-GETC pattern the page names, ge_units and degree_elective_units are left null; the table may be outdated.

outcomes: Program majors will demonstrate and articulate professional verbal expression.
Through active listening, program majors will critically analyze verbal and nonverbal messages in a variety of contexts.
Program majors will make ethical communication decisions based on an understanding of cultural diversity.

blocks.name: List B, or any List A course not already used

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score; checks.arithmetic, coverage, invented and the record unchanged
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
